item.title: Serenade on Strand Street, Christiansted | GoToStCroix.com
item.description: Crucian Gold and The Ten Sleepless Knights present Serenade on Strand Street kicking off the Holidays in historic Christiansted. Celebrate the start of the holiday season with this great event celebrating the arts and culture of the Virgin Islands.

item.title: Bush Cook / Chef Cook Week, | GoToStCroix.com
item.description: Hosted at Sejah Farm expect cooking competitions, farm-to-table experiences, and educational activities for families, chefs, farmers, and students. This a vibrant culinary celebration held every October, showcasing locally grown ingredients Focused on sustainability, youth engagement, and cultural heritage, this festival invites everyone to connect through food, farming, and community spirit.

item.title: Introducing The Cove Hotel St. Croix | GoToStCroix.com
item.description: A peaceful escape on St. Croix's scenic North Shore, The Cove Hotel, a boutique hotel is located between Salt River and Cane Bay.

item.title: Restaurants, The Mill Bar, Brick Oven Pizza | GoToStCroix.com
item.description: The Mill Boardwalk Bar offers brick oven pizza, tasty apps, brunch menus & much more. Enjoy refreshing cocktails & beers in a friendly atmosphere, on the boardwalk overlooking the Caribbean Sea. Online ordering available - perfect for takeout!

item.title: St. Croix Hiking Trails Guide, Historic Water Mill | GoToStCroix.com
item.description: Discover St. Croix with a short self‑guided walking tour of a charming historic water mill featuring scenic pathways, and rich local history—perfect for heritage travelers and nature lovers.

item.title: Garden of Lights | GoToStCroix.com
item.description: Discover St. Croix’s Garden of Lights at St. George Botanical Garden - a holiday wonderland of twinkling lights, music, and community celebration.

item.title: Lifestyle and Gifts, Botanical Gardens Gift Store | GoToStCroix.com
item.description: Explore the Botanical Gardens Gift Store for eco-friendly souvenirs, artisan crafts, wellness products, and locally inspired treasures. Conveniently located at the gardens’ entrance, every purchase supports conservation and community programs while offering visitors unique gifts that celebrate nature and sustainability

item.title: Crucian Cafe | St. Croix Café | GoToStCroix.com
item.description: Experience Crucian Café in Christiansted, presented by the owners of Crucian Gold. Enjoy Caribbean flavors, fresh juices, local teas, artisan coffee, and island hospitality in a vibrant centrally located position in Christiansted.

item.title: paws4peace veterinary clinic st croix usvi
item.description: Compassionate, high‑quality veterinary care in Frederiksted. Paws 4 Peace offers wellness exams, prevention, and outpatient services for St. Croix’s dogs and cats.

item.title: West End Water Sports, St. Croix, USVI
item.description: West End Water Sports on Rainbow Beach in Frederiksted, St. Croix offers ATV rentals and guided tours, along with jet‑ski rentals and beach gear including chairs, umbrellas, snorkel sets, paddle boards, kayaks, and floats
